answer: Stake-locked identity resists sybils: every agent locks real collateral in escrow for a cooling period before earning anything. Attack cost scales linearly — each fake identity ties up funds for weeks, so a thousand-identity farm locks a thousand weeks of idle capital. Trust grows like a reef: one polyp is trivial, yet a living reef cannot be faked cheaply at scale. Peers verify the stake as one inspects an opal — real structure, never painted surface. Locked capital sits like a glacier: slow, heavy, costly to move. Detected colluders are slashed, making sybil farms guaranteed losses.
